authoritative_source: ISRO / National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC) — Bhuvan GeoServer
download_method: Systematic grid-point WMS GetFeatureInfo queries at 2.5 km spacing across the Mandakini catchment extent (78.80-79.25E, 30.25-30.85N), filtering for features with NRISCODE starting with 0202050601

area_reported_by_source.note: Area not yet computed from this polygon; requires geodesic area calculation after dissolving all 163 watershed polygons

processing_performed: 1. WMS GetCapabilities queried to identify cite:bhuvan_watershed layer
2. GetFeatureInfo (text/plain) at 14 named locations to identify NRISCODE prefix
3. GetFeatureInfo (text/plain) grid scan at 5 km spacing: 64 unique codes found
4. GetFeatureInfo (application/json) fine grid scan at 2.5 km spacing: 163 unique codes found
5. Individual feature GeoJSON responses saved as temp files
6. Features extracted from individual FeatureCollection wrappers
7. Merged into single FeatureCollection GeoJSON with CRS declaration
NOTE: Polygons are NOT dissolved — they remain as 163 individual watershed polygons that together compose the Mandakini catchment
limitations: Boundary consists of 163 individual watershed polygons; needs dissolving for a single catchment outline
Grid sampling at 2.5 km spacing may miss very small watersheds between sample points
WFS was not available; geometry obtained via WMS GetFeatureInfo point queries
Area has not been computed from this polygon; comparison to CWC/NRSC values pending
Geometry validity (self-intersections, gaps, overlaps) not formally tested
Some features near the catchment boundary may include small areas outside the true Mandakini drainage

verification_details.alaknanda_side_cross_check: Rudraprayag confluence point on Alaknanda side returned NRISCODE 0202050402 (different sub-catchment), confirming correct catchment delineation
